01.Who I Am

I'm a robotics engineer specializing in autonomous systems for the automotive domain — building software that lets vehicles perceive, localize, plan, and act in complex real-world environments.

My work spans the full autonomy stack. On the perception side, I integrate mmWave radar, 3D LiDAR, multi-camera rigs, GNSS, and IMUs into robust sensor fusion pipelines that hold up under degraded conditions and edge cases.

On the planning and control side, I design motion planning modules and drive-by-wire inspired control systems that bridge the gap between simulation and physical deployment. I care as much about making a system maintainable and testable as I do about making it work.

02.Where I've Worked

Staff Research Engineer @ Gahan AI

Jan 2026 – Present

  • Built the full ROS 2 perception stack for an NHAI PoC vehicle focused on road surface analysis — wrote sensor bringup nodes for all onboard sensors, performed LiDAR-camera extrinsic calibration using fast-calib with point projection onto the camera frame, and implemented a LiDAR-based IRI (International Roughness Index) calculator alongside a road defect detection pipeline for identifying cracks, potholes, and surface irregularities.
  • Authored a custom ROS 2 driver for an in-house 4D radar over CAN, enabling the sensor’s data to be consumed natively within the ROS ecosystem for the first time at the company.
  • Developed the radar-camera extrinsic calibration pipeline and implemented radar-camera fusion, then built AIS-compliant ADAS warning systems on top — FCW (Forward Collision Warning), MOIS (Moving Off Information System), and LDW (Lane Departure Warning).
  • Leading the ongoing reconstruction of the Open-ADAS project — upgrading the compute platform from Jetson Nano to Jetson Orin NX and expanding the sensor suite from camera-only to a combined camera + 4D radar + 3D radar configuration.

Robotics Research Engineer II @ Gahan AI

May 2025 – Dec 2025

  • Developed firmware for the TI AWR1843 mmWave radar development board, authoring three distinct chirp configurations targeting long, medium, and short detection ranges.
  • Using the short-range configuration, built a BSIS (Blind Spot Information System) and RCW (Rear Collision Warning) application for a two-wheeler platform — BSIS consumed the radar’s detected object lists while RCW operated on tracked object lists combined with TTC-based warning thresholds; both applications surfaced warnings via LED outputs.
  • Designed and implemented a custom 3D navigation stack for the golf cart buggy, replacing the standard Nav2 pipeline with a purpose-built solution suited for the platform’s geometry and outdoor environment.

Robotics Research Intern @ Gahan AI

Dec 2024 – Apr 2025

  • Performed LiDAR-camera extrinsic calibration using the MATLAB calibrator tool with a checkerboard target visible to both sensors simultaneously.
  • Evaluated and benchmarked multiple ROS 2 Humble SLAM algorithms — LIO-SAM, LiDAR SLAM ROS2 (Tier IV / R. Sasaki), MOLA, and SLAM Toolbox (2D laser scan) — and built a Nav2-based localization and navigation stack for a golf cart buggy platform.
  • Wrote custom wheel odometry nodes using encoder counts and steering feedback, then fused the output with GNSS and IMU data via the robot_localization package to produce filtered global odometry.
  • Developed a proof-of-concept Fleet Management System on a Raspberry Pi 5 using dual cameras, a NEO-7M GNSS module, and a BNO085 IMU — functioning as a lightweight driver monitoring system.

Robotics Intern — Autonomous Navigation @ KLE Technological University and C.A.S.E

Jan 2024 – Jul 2024

Worked on SLAM and autonomous navigation using the ROS 2 Nav2 stack, with a focus on GPS-based outdoor navigation. Implemented and tuned Nav2 for real robot deployment, integrating GPS localisation to enable waypoint following and autonomous movement in outdoor environments.

Virtual Intern — AI & Signal Processing @ AICTE and MathWorks

May 2023 – Aug 2023

Completed the MathWorks Virtual Internship Program (MVIP) — a structured 4-month curriculum covering MATLAB, image processing, signal processing, machine learning, and deep learning. Applied spectral analysis and filtering techniques on signal data, performed image segmentation and batch classification, and trained deep neural networks for image classification using MATLAB. Earned joint AICTE–MathWorks completion certificates across all five courses.

Autonomous Navigational Robot

A sponsored research project building a full-stack autonomous robot — from MBSE-driven architecture using MATLAB System Composer, to GPS RTK + LiDAR sensor integration, PID-based motor and BMS control, and sensor fusion with path planning for obstacle-aware navigation in real environments.

4-DOF Delta Robot
